critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~702 lines) is approaching the 700-line file-size threshold — consider splitting marketing/payments endpoints into a separate router module (e.g. /app/backend/routes/marketing.py) before Phase 2 adds Stripe/PayPal webhook logic.

ContactInput.email uses Field(min_length=3) but the manual '@'/'.' check inside the handler returns 400 while pydantic-level invalid emails return 422 — not a bug, but the inconsistent status codes are tested for and worth documenting. Switching to pydantic.EmailStr would be cleaner and remove the manual check.
